questions.question: What appeared during Belshazzar's feast in chapter 5?
options: A statue toppling from its base
A scroll unrolling in the air
A lampstand going dark at once
A hand writing on the wall
questions.answer: A hand writing on the wall

questions.question: What did the writing 'MENE, MENE, TEKEL, PARSIN' mean?
options: God had numbered the kingdom's days, weighed the king and found him wanting, and divided the kingdom
God would very soon deliver the whole of the city from the great Persian army gathered outside the gates
God would raise up a brand new and far greater temple built up entirely in the king's own great honor
God would restore the king again to his royal throne once more after seven long years of raving madness
questions.answer: God had numbered the kingdom's days, weighed the king and found him wanting, and divided the kingdom

questions.question: That very night Belshazzar was killed and Darius the Mede received the kingdom.
